description.from: Deliver a small, auditable toolkit that improves decision alignment from trusted labels. First deliver the Decision Context Optimizer: fixed global context selection and target-conditioned retrieval, compared at explicit example and token budgets. Support Jev, Kev, and Laya through declared capabilities, then extract reusable feedback and learned-head mechanics from Jev-Flywheel. Dataset preparation and empirical claims belong in https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations; historical evidence remains in https://github.com/AnthusAI/Few-Shot-Jev. Completion requires reproducible optimizer artifacts, fake-client specs, a runnable offline example, and linked evaluation evidence. Creating this roadmap authorizes planning only; individual live studies retain their own preregistration and collection gates.
description.to:
Deliver a small, model-neutral toolkit that improves decision alignment from trusted labels. Start with the Decision Context Optimizer, explicit model capabilities, and reproducible policies. Then extract the existing trusted-feedback, learned-head, and human-reviewed steering mechanics from Jev-Flywheel. Dataset preparation and actual studies belong in the companion evaluations board.

Companion initiative: decision-flywheel-evaluations-049a2c8b-1798-5cf5-8a81-3cda98d0f924 in https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/tree/main/project/issues.

Completion: Jev/Kev/Laya capability conformance, automated development-only selection, versioned artifacts, fake-client specs, a complete offline walkthrough, and linked experimental evidence. The optional DSPy bridge must demonstrate automated optimization, not inference alone.
